description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Order to impose Special Commodity Levy on Fish, Coconut, Cashewnut etc., for a 6 month period from 14.12.2017
categorisation: This gazette content involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory orders specifying tax rates on specific commodities (fish and coconut kernel) and rescinds previous orders. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel/structure, land, commercial, elections, public service, judicial, or other specialized categories.
